name: Chitkara University
overview:
ADDITIONAL PROGRAMME SPECIFICS


  • Not recommended for female students


CHITKARA UNIVERSITY


Chitkara University is located in the North of India, near the city of Chandigarh.

Founded in 2010, it offers bachelors, masters and doctoral programs, entirely in English, in the fields of Engineering Management, IT, Pharmacy and many others, and welcomes nearly 7,000 students.

This very modern University has connections with influential companies such as Google, Accenture, and Deloitte. Chitkara University makes it a point of honor to promote research, innovation and entrepreneurship through these partnerships.

For advice to travelers issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on this country, click here.
administrative:
1. Application Dossier


You will be working directly with the partner university regarding your application.


Your host university may ask for the following documents:

  • Copy of passport (valid 6 months after the end of the stay)
  • The application form with a photo ID
  • Resume in English
  • Transcripts in English (will be provided directly by the Epitech IAFF team)
  • Certificate of education in English (to be requested from the administration of your campus)
  • Tepitech certificate downloadable from the intra
  • Motivation letter


To be given to Epitech campus administration:

  • Addendum to the contract
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


This information is subject to change by the partner university. They will provide you with the most current information upon your acceptance.


2. Receipt of Acceptance Letter


Once your application has been accepted by Chitkara University, you will receive an admission letter and can then start the following steps.


3. Visa Application


Once your file has been accepted by Epitech and by Chitkara University, a good part of the process is done, but not all. The last step is to obtain your visa following the procedures indicated below.

  • First, complete the Indian Government online visa application form.
  • (Check student visa, exchange programme)
  • Website: indianvisaonline.gov.in/visa/index.html
  • Then submit your request to VFS Global by carefully reading the information:
  • Website: vfsglobal.com/india/france/Student_Visa.html
  • Embassy of India in France (visa requirements and procedure):
  • Website: eoiparis.gov.in/page/visa-services/


4.Insurance and Health


It is imperative that you take out insurance that will cover you for your medical and hospital expenses, repatriation and accompanied by civil liability. International insurance must cover the entire period of your studies in the country. Insurance costs are the responsibility of each student.

To take out international insurance, the market is quite open. Please click here for more information.


For more information, you can consult the country's health file at: https://www.pasteur.fr/fr/centre-medical/preparer-son-voyage/inde

Note: It is advisable to register on the French register established outside France and to report to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs via the Ariane platform: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html.


5.Campus Life


Chitkara University is located 30 km from Chandigarh, which serves as the capital of the two neighboring states of Punjab and Haryana.


Chandigarh is one of the first planned cities in India and is internationally known for its urban design and architecture, particularly that of architect Le Corbusier.


It also boasts one of the highest per capita incomes in the country, and is reported to be India’s happiest and cleanest city.
accomodation:
At Chitkara University, you will be among the many students coming from all across the country to live in Chitkara residences, which come closest to being a home away from home. Separate facilities for boys and girls, caring wardens and tight security arrangements ensure a pleasant stay, allowing students to focus on academics. Internet access and Subscriber Trunk Dialling (STD) facilities ensure close contact with family and friends outside. The common rooms are fully equipped with TV, indoor games and other recreation facilities.


Hostel charges (2025): AC rooms – ₹1,05,000/year; Non-AC rooms – ₹85,000/year. Hostel fees include accommodation, and other services as specified by the university.

Important Notes

  • The course list is given for information only. It can change from year to year.
  • If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.
  • Any Tech 4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance it.
cost:
Financial overview (4th year Epitech)

  • You must pay the tuition fees for the 4th year of EPITECH, as well as the re-registration fees and related fees.
  • EPITECH covers the tuition fees.
  • Other costs at your expense include: travel, accommodation on site, insurance, and everyday expenses (books, food, transport, etc.).


Other Expenses

  • Roundtrip flights: from 800€
  • Insurance: 300-600€ depending on the coverage
  • Visa: 100€
  • Academic supplies: € 26 per month
  • University uniform: 100 € (payable at the start of the academic year)


Estimated monthly budget


The local currency is the Indian rupee. 1 € = 101 INR (rate in October 2025)


Please note that everyone's budget will be different according to one's lifestyle.


Housing : 800€/year


Food & eating out : 4€/meal, approximately 80€


Transportation : 30-60€


Phone, internet : 15-30€


Leisure : 50-100€


These prices are indicative and may vary.
